text:
Keisha: tiny design review for compare table — focusing on reordering, mobile layout, and a11y callouts. figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-reorder-v3

Tom: noticed the drag handle vs checkbox conflict. if users want to reorder, drag handle needs a larger hit area on touch. current 8px is too small.

Lina: agree. on mobile we should avoid drag-to-reorder in the list view. propose a 'Reorder' mode that toggles UI into move-up/down buttons — easier for accessibility and small screens.

Ben: copy for the reorder toggle? current label "Reorder rows" is fine but add microcopy: "Use keyboard: select row then press ▲/▼ or click move". helps power users.

Pablo: visual idea: instead of colored performance badges on mobile, show a single summary pill that says "Perf: 32ms p50" to avoid horizontal overflow. expand into chips on desktop.

AccessibilityBot: scan notes: drag handles are not keyboard operable. recommend adding aria-grabbed and keyboard controls (move up/down). Also ensure live region announces "Row moved to position X".

Keisha: good catch. decision: implement keyboard move controls with aria-live updates and a dedicated move control when focused. Lina — can you mock the move-control states?

Lina: yep. will show 1) drag mode with larger grips, 2) move-control mode with ▲/▼ buttons and focus outlines, and 3) mobile summary pill variant.

Tom: button affordance: use icon-only for compact rows but include visually-hidden text for screen readers: <button aria-label="Move row up">▲</button>. add tooltip on hover for desktop.

Ben: microcopy tweak for compare CTA: change "Compare" to "Compare selected models (3)" when more than one selected. also disable when <2 selected with tooltip "Select at least two models to compare". reduces confusion.

Pablo: colorblindness note: some perf badges use red/green pairs that fail for protanopia. propose adding a secondary patterned dot or left icon to indicate band (fast/ok/slow).

AccessibilityBot: pattern recommendation accepted. also flagged focus ring color contrast in compact mode — current ring uses 30% opacity on brand-blue; suggest full contrast outline (2px) for keyboard visibility.

Keisha: timeline: Lina to post mocks for three states by tomorrow, Ben to update copy strings and tooltips, Pablo to add CB-safe iconography, Tom to size hit targets. AccessibilityBot will re-run checks after mocks.

Lina: quick mock note: mobile summary pill uses "Perf • 32ms" and expands to chips on tap. will include reduced-motion animation.

Ben: i'll add the tooltip text and the CTA dynamic label. will also add translation-friendly version: "Compare selected models ({count})".

Pablo: adding patterned dot to tokens and updating design tokens path. pinging @Keisha when ready.

AccessibilityBot: reminder: include aria-live="polite" for move announcements and ensure role="status" on the region.

Keisha: thanks team. leaving thread open until mocks + a11y pass. :thumbsup:
